completion:
# Instructions for ensuring building accessibility in Sikkim

1. Use the Sikkim Building Code Section XII for guidelines for building accessibility.
2. Use Sikkim's Building Bylaws from 2008 for accessible building design.
3. Include accessibility checklists during building permit review.
4. Provide guidance to developers on inclusive design standards.
5. Penalize non-compliance with accessibility standards.
6. Educate developers and designers on accessible design.
7. Ensure accessible parking is provided.
8. Make ramps, lifts, and elevators accessible for PWDs.
9. Ensure braille signs are provided in public buildings.
10. Make sure toilets are accessible to PWDs.
11. Ensure public buildings have access ramps.
12. Conduct accessibility audits of public buildings.
13. Provide public awareness on accessibility needs of PWDs.
14. Encourage developers to follow accessibility standards.
